quality_gates: greenfield commercial ideas complete or explicitly skip the idea pressure test before Gate 1
idea pressure test declares continue, pivot, research-needed, or pause with a core assumption and fast disconfirming test
SDD mode is explicit: vibe-prototype, spec-lite, full-sdd, or production-hardening
scope-slice packs declare in_pack, referenced_only, and future_pack boundaries
docs-first packs index existing markdown documents and separate prescriptive inputs from this pack's ownership
live research completed or blocked explicitly
research ledger declares research_depth and unverified_claims
discovery brainstorming records mode, critical questions, options, and assumptions
all requirements have EARS acceptance criteria
all major stack choices cite official docs and current open-source evidence
major architecture choices answer real pain solved, stage fit, one-year technical debt, team scaling cost, migration or rollback path, and evidence source
frontend architecture decisions cover rendering, state ownership, motion, component/design-system choice, performance, and accessibility when UI exists
backend architecture decisions cover deployment shape, domain boundaries, API style, async/workflow, caching, and invalidation when backend exists
data architecture decisions cover store choice, schema/migrations, indexes/query paths, transactions/consistency, retention, and privacy when data exists
algorithm and data-structure decisions are explicit for search, ranking, rate limits, scheduling, queues, graph traversal, matching, recommendation, or retrieval when relevant
all major subsystems include a reuse, integration, fork, pattern-extraction, or build-from-scratch decision
state truth model declares persisted, runtime-only, derived, reset, snapshot, diff, and migration behavior
workflow/navigation/action contract declares routes, screens, dialogs, commands, transitions, side effects, and invalid transitions
module/file responsibility contract declares ownership, allowed content, forbidden content, dependency direction, and public interfaces
generated artifact contract maps each generated output to a source declaration, generator command, and no-hand-edit rule
deterministic judge/evidence contract maps each requirement to code, state, API, file, screenshot, log, or manual evidence
architecture fitness checks validate selected frontend, backend, data, and algorithm decisions with concrete evidence
cache and consistency contracts define source of truth, cache layer, invalidation, staleness budget, and failure behavior when caching exists
data access and index contracts define query path, owner, cardinality, index/search structure, permission filter, and validation when data exists
data sufficiency check confirms fixtures, default data, reference cases, bad cases, regression cases, and edge cases support the planned workflows
stage gates require confirmation after brief plus research and after PRD plus requirements plus technical design
single-pass generation records gates_skipped in handoff_manifest.json
feature-mode packs include existing-system reality, compatibility contract, integration plan, and regression cases
reference, bad, and regression cases declare provenance as user-confirmed, real-source-derived, existing-test-derived, or synthetic
build-ready evals include at least one non-synthetic reference case
build-ready handoffs include non-empty automated checks and runnable validation commands or explicit manual-only markings
launch-ready handoffs include security, performance, monitoring, CI/CD, environment separation, and rollback evidence
UI-heavy packs include 08-ui-visual-design.md or explicitly state why it is omitted
08-ui-visual-design.md, when present, is connected to 06 UI Judge and 07 design implementation phase
all tasks include validation commands or evidence requirements
agent execution plan includes prompt packets with role, context, task, constraints, output format, and validation evidence
architecture workstream prompt packets split frontend, backend, data, and algorithm workstreams when those surfaces exist
living spec update protocol requires upstream docs and traceability updates when implementation changes behavior, API, schema, permissions, security, visual contract, or eval evidence
traceability maps requirements to design, contracts, tasks, and evals
